name: Quick Actions & Clock
description: Shared Home Assistant actions and optional clock for Kiosk dashboard, screensavers and Fotoo, with battery icons and per-item visibility rules.
author: Local Kiosk Satellite project

settings.title: Show on
settings.description: Choose which screensavers show the action rail.

settings.description: Anchor point for the action rail.

settings.title: Layout
settings.description: Stack actions vertically or horizontally.

settings.title: Picture size
settings.description: Avatar/icon size for each item.

settings.title: Spacing
settings.description: Space between items.

settings.title: Opacity
settings.description: Opacity of the action rail.

settings.title: Show names and states
settings.description: Show friendly name and current state beside the picture.

settings.title: Item order & visibility
settings.description: Order first, then optional per-item rules after #. Example: 1,2,3,4,5,6 # 1=binary_sensor.motion|Active;3=sensor.lux|Numeric below|30
